Import your calendar

Paste your school timetable, a copied table, or calendar text. English and Dutch both work, like “Maandag 8u25-9u15 Wiskunde” or “Mon 8:25-9:15 Math (room 12)”.

Paste the iCal link from Google Calendar (Settings, then Secret address in iCal format), Smartschool, Outlook or your school. VEX keeps it up to date.
